question: Which six continents and six oceans follow the salt ocean in order?
premises: The six continents are successively doubled in size and ruled by six sons of Manu.
The continents are Shaka, Kusha, Krauncha, Shalmali, Gomeda, and Pushkara.
The six oceans are of milk, curd, ghee, sugarcane juice, liquor, and sweet water.
inference: Beyond the salt ocean the world expands through six named continents and six corresponding oceans in a fixed order.
plain_english: The six continents, each successively doubled in size and ruled by six sons of Manu, are Shaka, Kusha, Krauncha, Shalmali, Gomeda, and Pushkara. Their six oceans are of milk, curd, ghee, sugarcane juice, liquor, and sweet water.
